verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server that works with any MCP client, plus management APIs for connections and transformations. It also offers an Audiences feature for building and activating audiences downstream, and marketing claims AI chat interfaces let teams 'analyze, segment, and activate data'. However, the documented MCP capabilities cover debugging, transformations, tracking plans, audit logs and docs Q&A, not querying customer profiles or creating and activating audiences, and no API is shown for audience management. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for querying customer or profile data, programmatic audience creation and activation endpoints, an end-to-end agent workflow example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
